 BOSTON, MA -- The Minnesota Wild looks to extend its point streak to 11 games and its road win streak to eight games tonight in Boston at 6:00 p.m. CT on Wild+ and KOOL FM 107.9.
 Projected lineup is subject to change. 
 FORWARDS 
 97 Kirill Kaprizov - 14 Joel Eriksson Ek - 12 Matt Boldy
 49 Maxim Shabanov - 22 Danila Yurov - 13 Yakov Trenin
 20 Blake Coleman - 47 Michael McCarron - 10 Bobby Brink
 17 Marcus Foligno - 38 Ryan Hartman - 71 Nick Foligno
 DEFENSE 
 43 Quinn Hughes - 7 Brock Faber
 25 Jonas Brodin - 46 Jared Spurgeon
 3 Olli Maatta - 24 Zach Bogosian
 GOALTENDERS 
 30 Jesper Wallstedt
 31 Calvin Pickard

 When: Saturday, November 14 at 6:00 p.m. CT
